recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖：箭頭標示 13、14、18、22 號染色體異常，單一條 8 號與 17 號染色體（-8、-17），並另排一組標記染色體（mar）；下方核型式寫明 t(14;18)(q32;q21)，這是濾泡性淋巴瘤的特徵易位（IGH::BCL2）。
features: GTG-banded karyogram at ~400 band resolution, male (XY), 50 metaphases analyzed
Only one chromosome 8 and one chromosome 17 are displayed (monosomy 8 and 17)
A separate 'mar' slot shows two unidentified marker chromosomes
describe_en: Conventional G-banded chromosome analysis of 50 metaphases shows an abnormal clone in 15 cells and a normal male karyotype in 35 cells. The abnormal clone carries t(14;18)(q32;q21), additional material on 13q34, a 22q11 deletion and loss of chromosomes 8 and 17, and the karyogram displays two marker chromosomes that restore the modal number to 46; note that the written karyotype omits +2mar, which should be reconciled with the laboratory report. This is a non-morphologic figure. The t(14;18) indicates IGH::BCL2 rearrangement consistent with a follicular lymphoma-derived clone, and the complex secondary abnormalities (including 17/TP53 loss) support possible transformation to large B-cell lymphoma in the clinical context.

ddx.dx: De novo diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with BCL2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Cytogenetics cannot separate de novo from transformed DLBCL; history or histologic evidence of a follicular component is required.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma additionally shows an 8q24 MYC rearrangement (e.g., t(8;14) or variant), which is not described here, and should be excluded by MYC FISH.
MCL carries t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH rather than t(14;18).
Burkitt lymphoma is defined by t(8;14)(q24;q32) or variants with a usually simple karyotype, not t(14;18).
